overview_description.description:
For local governments that struggle to access and understand mountains of data that can help them take effective, efficient action, they deliver leading cloud-based data management services combined with user-friendly software analysis tools that work seamlessly with existing systems to combine messy, scattered data and deliver simple, clear insights needed to solve community and neighborhood priorities. 

The Tolemi platform was launched in 2016, and their partners include some of the most forward-thinking public sector agencies from across the country. Tolemi is funded by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Y Combinator, and Fika Ventures. The Company is based in Boston, Massachusetts.

product.name: BuildingBlocks
product.description: A platform that integrates city data from multiple departments into a single, web-based tool for real-time property information and analytics.

product.name: City Analytics
product.description: Tools and features within BuildingBlocks that provide insights and analytics on city data, including property conditions, sales, permits, and land use.

product.name: Rental Property Inspections
product.description: A service that helps cities manage and prioritize rental property inspections based on risk factors and compliance status.

product.name: Rental Property Registration Ordinance
product.description: A system for registering rental properties, collecting fees, scheduling inspections, and automating communications with landlords.

product.name: Housing
product.description: Services and tools aimed at protecting renters and homeowners, tracking housing instability, and preventing foreclosures.

product.name: Foreclosures
product.description: Tracking and monitoring of pre-foreclosure filings to provide early warnings and support to at-risk homeowners.
